question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Repeal
solution:
The correct answer is: **Approval**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Repeal"** means to revoke or annul (a law or congressional act). It is the action of reversing or canceling an existing law or regulation. (रद्द करना)

 
 
• **Example: **The government decided to repeal the outdated law, allowing for more modern regulations to take its place.
 
 

 
• **"Approval" **refers to the action of officially agreeing to something or accepting something as satisfactory. It is the antonym of repeal as it implies endorsement rather than cancellation. (अनुमोदन)

 
 
• **Example: **The new policy received approval from the board, signaling its implementation in the coming months.
 
 

 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Repeal' **is **'Approval'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Approval**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Expense **(खर्च): The cost required for something; the money spent on something.

 
 
• **Example:** The total expense of the project was higher than initially estimated.
 
 

 
• **Separation **(अलगाव): The action or state of moving or being moved apart.

 
 
• **Example: **After years of working together, the partners decided on a separation of their business interests.
 
 

 
• **Adversity** (विपत्ति): Difficulties or misfortune.

 
 
• **Example:** She overcame great adversity to achieve her current level of success.
